test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: All metals are elements. Some elements are gases. All gases are matters.

Conclusions: I. Some elements are matters. II. Some matters are metals. ?
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bb0da7c969548129a85f936c7dff3cab3d4a9b5829e51ed79e6ce68db455247.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some elements are matters → **Follow** (As some elements are gases and all gases are matters. so, some elements are definitely matters).

II. Some matters are metals → **Does not follow **(There is no direction relation given between metals and matters).

Only I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
